data-table.label: Event ID
data-table.description: Unique identifier for each tracked action, sortable alphanumerically

data-table.label: Timestamp
data-table.description: Precise date and time of the event, sortable newest-to-oldest by default

data-table.label: User
data-table.description: Display name or anonymised ID of the actor who triggered the event

data-table.label: Event Type
data-table.description: Categorised label such as Subscription Upgraded, Page Viewed, or Export Triggered

data-table.label: Channel
data-table.description: Acquisition or interaction source: Organic, Paid, Referral, or Direct

data-table.label: Revenue Impact
data-table.description: Monetary delta in USD attributed to this event; blank for non-revenue events

data-table.label: Status
data-table.description: Color-coded badge: Completed (indigo), Pending (amber), Failed (red), Refunded (slate)

data-table.label: Actions
data-table.description: Row-level controls: View Details, Copy ID, Flag for Review
